line: Crowley's Five of Swords is the card for the first decan of Aquarius, with Venus as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Aquarius.

quotes.quote: The Five of Swords is similarly troublesome; the card is called Defeat.
as Venus here rules Aquarius, weakness

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: The intellect has been enfeebled by sentiment.
